A '''sonic generator droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] employed by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. It was part of preparations against a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] attack on [[Centerpoint Station]]. They resembled [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], but with a sonic generator instead of a head. They could bring down Jedi alive with a sonic attack. Nearby [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] used sound cancellers to prevent collateral damage.
